title: Pilot study

blocks.heading: Pilot study
blocks.text: A pilot study is a small preliminary trial of research procedures or instruments used to identify problems and make improvements before the main enquiry. Try with relevant volunteers, record difficulties, revise the instrument and check the revision. Pilot answers do not establish the whole population’s pattern.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Worked enquiry connection
blocks.text: Describe a pilot for an invented water questionnaire whose draft asks whether journeys are “long”. Try it with relevant volunteers, note requests to define long, replace it with return minutes including waiting, and retry to check understanding before main collection.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated
